title: Idea Quality Eval
description: REPORT-stage deep-ideation artifact. Output of tools/idea_quality_eval.py (the blind pairwise quality harness). It scores every candidate idea on a DECOMPOSED, auditable set of quality dimensions computed deterministically from the run's typed artifacts (mechanism_graph depth & branching -> depth; mechanism_mapping cross-domain edges -> breadth; citation resolvability / evidence diversity -> grounding; contradiction coverage -> refutation; experiment_sketch falsifier presence -> falsifiability; novelty-collision verdicts -> novelty) and records blind PAIRWISE comparisons per dimension. HARD design rule (the report's §测试与评估): the harness NEVER emits a single collapsed total that could be read as a bet, and carries NO recommended / best / chosen field — pairwise winners are per-dimension EVIDENCE (mirroring elo_tournament), not a global selection. Measurement / advisory ONLY: it never cuts an idea and never gates a stage. Every score is DERIVED by the tool, never hand-set. stability (run-to-run consistency) and cost (token/tool per idea) are OPTIONAL: present only when multi-run / budget telemetry exists — never fabricated.

eval_id.description: Short unique identifier for this eval, e.g. QE-001. Non-blank.

per_idea.description: One decomposed scorecard per candidate idea. minItems:1.

idea_id.description: The idea scored, e.g. IDEA-1. Non-blank.

scores.description: Decomposed quality scores, each in [0,1], DERIVED from artifacts. The 6 required dimensions are always derivable from a single run; stability/cost are optional (telemetry-dependent). A single collapsed total is deliberately ABSENT (no bet-by-total).

depth.description: Mechanism-graph depth & branching (did the idea reach the underlying mechanism, or stay shallow).

breadth.description: Cross-domain reach: mechanism_mapping edges / distinct source domains (real transfer, not word-swap).

grounding.description: Resolvable-citation rate + evidence diversity (traceable, not single-source).

refutation.description: Contradiction/counterexample coverage (did it survive adversarial checking).

falsifiability.description: Experiment-sketch completeness + falsifier presence (can it enter a real experiment).

novelty.description: Prior-art-collision posture (avoids pseudo-novelty); derived from the collision verdict, never a raw score-cut.

stability.description: Optional: run-to-run consistency (blind pairwise win-rate / Elo variance). Present only with multi-run telemetry.

cost.description: Optional: token / tool-call efficiency per idea. Present only with budget telemetry.

evidence_ref.description: Anti-slop: the artifact path(s) each score was derived from (e.g. evidence/DISCOVER/mechanism-graph.artifact.json).

notes.description: Optional: which dimensions were unavailable (e.g. stability requires multiple runs).

pairwise.description: Blind per-dimension pairwise comparisons (EVIDENCE, not a bet). May be empty when fewer than 2 ideas. winner is one of the two idea_ids or 'tie' (deterministic: higher score on that dimension).

dimension.description: Which decomposed dimension this comparison is on.

winner.description: The idea_id with the higher score on this dimension, or 'tie'. Per-dimension only — never a global selection.

rationale_ref.description: Optional: pointer to the score basis (e.g. the two evidence_refs compared).

notes.description: Optional eval-level caveats (e.g. 'cost omitted — no budget telemetry this run').
